# Nadeem Ahmad — Complete Technical Knowledge Base & AI Resume

## Candidate Profile
Nadeem Ahmad is a Machine Learning Engineer based in Chiniot District, Punjab, Pakistan. He currently serves as a Machine Learning Engineer at NeuroWebLabs while pursuing his B.S. in Software Engineering at FAST NUCES.

With over 3 years of hands-on experience in full-stack AI development and nearly 2 years dedicated to machine learning, Nadeem specializes in taking complex AI algorithms from research to high-throughput production environments.

## Engineering Philosophy
1. Full Architectural Accountability: Takes 100% ownership of engineering decisions, system performance, and delivery outcomes.
2. Cost-Efficient Hybrid AI Architectures: Combines local open-weight LLMs, vector database caching, and fine-tuned models to reduce API and compute costs by up to 70%.
3. High-Impact User Interfaces: Blends cutting-edge backend AI orchestration with fast, intuitive web interfaces (Next.js 14, React, TypeScript).
